name: infographic-design
description: Make a single infographic image for a LinkedIn or feed post that still reads when the text is blurred and the post is reposted. Bundles two skills: infographic-mindset (when an image earns its place, the three tests — one message in three seconds, the blur test, a body-text budget — a line-by-line wording read (names defined before use, titles and verdicts as sentences with a subject, positive wording, evidence beside each verdict), color roles with one accent, a type scale with a 16px floor, four design schemes taken from finished post images: two-panel concept/system map, question + measured data cards + bars, tension headline + structure compare + case in the same silhouette, two definition panels + one framework mapped onto the other, and how the image and the post body divide the work), and infographic-build (tokens.css + base.css, four HTML/SVG templates, render.py for Chromium PNG + layout/text report + one PNG per band + the words in reading order, lint.py for overflow, text budget, minimum size, light small text, one accent, no literal hex, band gap and short last lines, and a defects table from real renders). Korean-first (Noto Sans CJK KR), 1080x1350 portrait or 1200x800 landscape at 2x.
